description: Death, reimagined: graves, ghosts, and a graveyard dimension. Pay the Ferryman - or enlist in the war of the dead. Server-side Fabric, Bedrock-friendly. ModJam 2026.

mods.name: Charon's Echo
mods.description: Death, reimagined: graves, ghosts, and a graveyard dimension. Your items go to a headstone in Charon's dusk-lit world of the dead — cross the portal as a ghost and settle with the Ferryman: pay the fare, pay the XP toll, or enlist in the war of the dead and earn your resurrection. Every death digs a grave with your epitaph; write your death story, lay flowers for the fallen, and walk a crypt that grows a hall for every month of your server's history. Corpse recovery with a mythology. Server-side, crossplay-ready (Geyser/Bedrock), no client mod required.
